sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8 is an abliterated (refusal-removed) and offline block-FP8 quantized build of Qwen's Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B — a 27B-parameter dense, hybrid-attention (Gated DeltaNet linear + full attention) native vision-language model with flexible thinking control, tool-calling, and an MTP speculative-decoding head.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8 is an abliterated and block-FP8 quantized version of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B, maintained by orcarouter. The model removes refusal mechanisms through orthogonalization of the safety direction from residual-writing matrices, then applies offline block-FP8 quantization (E4M3, 128×128 block size) matching the official Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 byte-for-byte. sources.snippet: The article details how the OrcaRouter team applied abliteration to Qwen3.8‑27B, removed the model's refusal direction, re‑quantized it to FP8, benchmarked unchanged general abilities but near‑zero refusal rates, and provides download links and deployment instructions for red‑team and safety research.
